crossRefs.note: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? Then may you also do good, who are accustomed to do evil.

and they served idols, of which Yahweh had said to them, “You shall not do this thing.”
To this day they do what they did before. They don’t fear Yahweh, and they do not follow the statutes, or the…
There you shall serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.

translations.web: However they didn’t listen, but they did what they did before.
translations.bsb: But they would not listen, and they persisted in their former customs.
translations.kjv: Howbeit they did not hearken, but they did after their former manner.
translations.asv: Howbeit they did not hearken, but they did after their former manner.
